title: Rust tests compile out peer-context liveness enforcement
description: AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext compress/decompress guard their InvalidPeerEvidence return with cfg(not(test)); stale/evidence-less contexts therefore succeed in unit tests even though production rejects them. No_std base methods are likewise exposed although retained evidence is always false. Remove test-only semantic divergence, test through properly issued evidence/authority, and make unusable base methods unavailable or consistently failing.
